cases.comparison: Dynamically load the prepared bashpython module before exercising the same prompt, execution, continuation, or EOF and terminal restoration contract as the historical case.
cases.candidate_script:
enable -f /opt/t018-python/usr/lib/bash-os/loadables/bashpython.so bashpython || exit 125

bashpython -q
echo "after=$?"
